responsibility: This implementation module is an empty compatibility stub for the Logitech DebugTrace facility. It contains no tracing logic or exported services and exists only to satisfy linkage and imports for legacy GNU Modula-2 programs.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the DebugTrace same-name pair: it provides the empty module body that matches DebugTrace.def, whereas the .def file is only the importable interface declaration.
